description.en: Hand-picked bundles for DeepSeek Harness: the balance whale widget, a word-selection translator, a desktop pet, a session deleter, and center-screen popups when an answer is done or waiting on you.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的五个自用增强插件：余额小鲸鱼挂件、划词翻译、桌面宠物、会话删除、回答完毕/需要操作时的屏幕居中弹窗。

description.en: When a main session finishes answering or needs you — approval, a question, an error, a token-limit cutoff — a topmost WinForms card pops dead-center on the monitor your cursor is on, with a sound. Not a taskbar toast. Subagents, delegated sessions and cancelled turns stay quiet; one window at a time.
description.zh: 主会话回答完毕、等你批准、向你提问、报错或输出被截断时，在鼠标所在屏幕正中央弹出置顶卡片并响提示音——不是能假装没看见的任务栏气泡。子代理/委派会话/主动取消不弹，同一时刻只弹一个窗。仅 Windows。

description.en: Really delete a session — including the one on screen and the one still running. The directory moves to sessions-trash, the row disappears at once, and you land on the empty view instead of a full page reload.
description.zh: 真正删掉一个会话——包括正打开着的和还在跑的。目录移进 sessions-trash，列表行立刻消失，退回空状态而不是整页刷新。

description.en: A pixel pet that lives in a corner of the DSH window: drag it around, it chatters on its own, throws tantrums and reacts to your work status.
description.zh: 住在 DSH 窗口角落里的桌面宠物：可拖拽、会自己碎碎念、会扔东西发脾气，也会跟着你的忙碌状态换动作。
